The '''Gospel of the True Gods''' was a collection of beliefs and tenets set upon the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] by the [[Yun'o|True Gods]]. If one were to be considered an adherent of the [[True Way]], one had to proclaim one's acceptance of the gospel.
